Question: How long have you been taking your current regular medicines?
When to ask: Always

Question: How many different regular medicines are you taking at the moment?
When to ask: Always

Question: Who usually collects or receives your prescriptions?
When to ask: Always

Question: Is there anything about your health that has changed in the last six months?
When to ask: Always

Question: In a typical week how often do you miss a dose?
When to ask: Always

Question: What tends to get in the way when a dose is missed?
When to ask: Only where PC2 is 4 or more

Question: Do you use any aid such as a dosette box or a phone reminder?
When to ask: Only where PC2 is 4 or more

Question: Can you talk me through how you take your inhaler?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an inhaled medicine

Question: When did someone last watch you use it?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an inhaled medicine

Question: Do you use a spacer?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an inhaled medicine

Question: How do you keep track of your anticoagulant dose?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an anticoagulant

Question: Have you had any unusual bruising or bleeding since your last review?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an anticoagulant

Question: Has anyone gone through what to do if you miss a dose?
When to ask: Only where the patient is prescribed an anticoagulant

Question: How well controlled is your pain on your current medicines?
When to ask: Only where the patient reports ongoing pain

Question: Have you needed to take more than the prescribed amount on any day?
When to ask: Only where the patient reports ongoing pain

Question: Have you noticed any effects you think might come from your medicines?
When to ask: Always

Question: Has anything led you to stop a medicine without telling anyone?
When to ask: Always

Question: Have you had a fall or near-fall in the last twelve months?
When to ask: Only where the patient is 65 or over

Question: Do you feel steady when you first stand up?
When to ask: Only where the patient is 65 or over

Question: Has the cost of prescriptions ever stopped you collecting one?
When to ask: Only where the patient pays for prescriptions

Question: What would make managing your medicines easier over the next few months?
When to ask: Always

Question: Is there anything we have not covered that you wanted to raise?
When to ask: Always
